archive_delivery: Full local primary candidates, ledgers and original clocks are delivered as a conversation attachment. This JSON is the repository provenance record, not a claim that the binary local archive has been uploaded to GitHub.
publication_execution: The complete source-bound remote execution is used for publication and retained separately in the repository. This choice precedes inspection of the remote outcomes. Clocks from the two machine executions are never mixed; they are not independent draws of training randomness.
scope: Deterministic registered design, no population confidence claim, no neural cost-superiority claim.
